EnumProperty.Name: DeploymentType
EnumProperty.Description: Specifies whether media files are emulated from the PC or deployed to the Xenon hard drive. Emulation can mimic game performance on DVD media.

BoolProperty.Name: SuppressStartupBanner
BoolProperty.Description: Suppress the display of the startup banner and information messages.

BoolProperty.Name: ExcludedFromBuild
BoolProperty.Description: Specifies whether the Console Deployment Tool is excluded from the build for the current configuration.

BoolProperty.Name: Progress
BoolProperty.Description: Displays status information about the progress of the deployment. (/PROGRESS)

BoolProperty.Name: ForceCopy
BoolProperty.Description: Forces the deployment tool to always copy files, even if the destination file size and date matches the source file. (/FORCECOPY)

StringListProperty.Name: DeploymentFiles
StringListProperty.Description: Specifies the source media files to deploy as well as their target locations on the console or synthesized DVD media. Select your own files or specify a Game Disc Layout file.

StringProperty.Name: RemoteRoot
StringProperty.Description: The full path of the directory (on the Console) where all deployment files will be copied to. This sets the value of the RemoteRoot macros. Example value: devkit:\$(SolutionName)

StringProperty.Name: RemotePath
StringProperty.Description: Remote Path : The full path (on the Console) where the xbe will be copied to. This sets the value of the RemotePath macros. Example value: devkit:\$(SolutionName)\$(TargetName).xex

EnumProperty.Name: DvdEmulationType
EnumProperty.Description: The different search times determine the accuracy of the emulation. Only the Accurate Search Times emulation type requires a user-defined DVD layout file (.XGD).

StringProperty.Name: LayoutFile
StringProperty.Description: User defined Game Disc Layout file (.xgd) that was created with the Xbox Game Disc Authoring Tool.
